learningObjectives: Build basic REST endpoints using FastAPI.
Define request and response schemas with Pydantic.
Organize API routes and validate incoming data.

activities.title: FastAPI Request Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of a FastAPI request from arrival to response.

content.concept: A FastAPI request is routed to an endpoint, validated when a schema is defined, processed by the path operation function, and converted into a response.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: FastAPI Route Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each part of the FastAPI endpoint to understand its role.

content.concept: A FastAPI route combines an HTTP method, URL path, Python function, and response.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Registers a GET endpoint and declares a path parameter.
Defines the Python function that handles the request.
Declares that the path parameter should be interpreted as an integer.
Returns response data that FastAPI can serialize as JSON.

activities.title: Pydantic Schema Builder
activities.instruction: Build a valid Pydantic request model.

content.concept: Pydantic models describe the expected structure and types of incoming data and allow FastAPI to validate request bodies.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: HTTP Method Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the HTTP method that best matches the operation.

content.concept: REST APIs commonly use GET for retrieval, POST for creation, PUT or PATCH for updates, and DELETE for removal.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
